simple.meaning: דֹּבֶר (dôber) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a pasture (from its arrangement of the flock).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 3 times in Isaiah, Jeremiah, Micah, beginning at Isaiah 5:17. The surrounding contexts include prophetic witness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דֹּבֶר (H1699) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: דֹּבֶר (dôber) / H1699 is traced through Isaiah 5:17, Jeremiah 5:13, Micah 2:12 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.short: a pasture (from its arrangement of the flock)
definitions.full: H1699. dober [ דֹּ֫בֶר ] noun [masculine] pasture (compare Aramaic דַּבְרָא , Syriac ) — suffix הַדָּֽבְרוֺ בְּתוֺךְ כְּעֵדֶר as a flock in the midst of its pasture Micah 2:12 (article with suffix, compare Ges § 127 , 4 b, who attaches ו as conjunction to following word); כְּדֳבְרָם כְבָשִׂים וְרָעזּ and lambs shall feed as (in) their pasture Isa 5:17 . דִּבֵּר noun [masculine] speaking (so Ew § 156 ) Jer 5:13 בָּהֶם אֵין וְהַדִּבֵּר ; according to Hi Gf Ki (less probably) verb with article for relation (see [ דָּבַר ] Pi`el ): but read rather הַדָּבָר , and the word is not in them .

occurrences.englishText: Then the lambs will graze as in their pasture,
The prophets will become wind, and the word is not in them. Thus it will be done to them.”
I will surely assemble, Jacob, all of you;
